answer: A cheap scorer must never grade for pay: it only triages, routing answers to random reasoning juries whose verdicts alone gate emission. Each fake identity then costs an attacker the same as a real one — every round it must mint a lantern-fresh, non-plagiarized mechanism and thread it past 5 uncorrelated jurors, who strike sable-cold on recycled or colluding work. Wrongly triaged answers still reach a sampled full panel, so no low-cost lane can whitelist a Sybil swarm. Price per fake identity therefore approaches the honest mining cost it mimics.
